verdict.rationale: Marlin is an autonomous research agent, so asking whether its runs or automations can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no versioning, change review, or rollback of runs or configurations. The ability to cancel a run mid-execution is an adjacent control, not rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
